configuration.cache: one excluded process warmup; OS/filesystem caches uncontrolled, no cold-cache claim; no route cache
configuration.timing: stage ns and whole process ns separately; includes timer launcher for process time
configuration.rss: whole-process peak, includes setup and serialization; not per-operation allocated bytes
configuration.diagnostic_modes: manifest diagnostics flag controls post-execution retained-buffer inventory only; stage clocks always enabled
configuration.percentiles: linear interpolation across process/stage samples; small descriptive sample, not service-tail evidence
